maria: quick note 10 raven-lite-quant canary shows intermittent non-JSON interjections in streaming funcalls (~3%). parser trips.
ravi: paste an example?
maria: ```
{"tool":"search","args":{"q":"redwood latency"}}
note: broadening to p99/p95
{"tool":"filter","args":{"k":"region","v":"us-west-2"}}
```
aj: odd. propose a non-destructive postprocess: detect non-JSON lines, try bounded repairs (drop common narrations like ^(note|thinking|debug):, merge up to 2 lines), mirror original stream to storage.
sam: add telemetry: repair_action {dropped,merged,failed}, snippet_id, model_variant. alert if repair_rate >1%. store raw snippets 30d TTL.
ravi: evaluation: A/B canary 50/50 raw vs stripped; collect parse_fail_rate, funcall_success_rate, schema_rejection_rate, per-field diffs. 5k samples per arm.
aj: feature flags: enable_strip_interjections=false, enable_stream_mirror=false. prototype tests + unit tests tomorrow.
canary-bot: scheduled canary split: raven-lite-quant v4 50/50 at 2026-01-08T09:00Z (job cny-9999). initial metrics (first 1k): parse_fail_rate(raw)=3.05%, stripped=0.85%, repair:dropped=1.7%,merged=0.3%,failed=0.05%.
maria: uploading annotated failures to #eng-ml for tuning. will report back.
